en.t: I glanced over at my mother beside me.

units.source_text: 母亲双手抓着念珠，站立在那里。

en.t: My mother stood there, clutching her prayer beads in both hands.

units.source_text: 她的脸僵硬，而身子仿佛凝固、缩小了，甚至可以放在掌上。

en.t: Her face was stiff, and her body seemed to have hardened and shrunk, small enough even to be placed on the palm of a hand.
